name: be-fit-extension
description: A free open-source browser extension that reminds everyone staring at a screen to stay fit and drop 20.

scripts.safari:xcode: node scripts/build.mjs safari && xcrun safari-web-extension-converter dist/safari --project-location dist/safari-xcode --app-name be-fit --bundle-identifier io.github.rsinghsd.befit --swift --copy-resources --no-open
